C1_site.prediction: S0 has the highest H5 on >= 4 of 6 tasks
C1_site.rule: per task best site = argmax H5 (rounded 0.01) over S0-S5; ties -> lower P15 ('not reached' = inf); remaining tie does not count for S0. CONFIRMED if count(S0 best) >= 4 of 6, raw p = P(X >= count | Bin(6, 1/6)) (4 -> 0.0087), passed to the iteration's secondary Holm family; DISCONFIRMED (generic perturbation) if one other site has H5 >= H5(S0) on >= 4 of 6; else PARTIAL with the per-task table. Per task D_t = H5(S0) - max_other H5 with a bootstrap CI (max inside replicates), P(S0 argmax) from the bootstrap, 0.10-Hill equivalence margin as sensitivity. If whole tasks are dropped the threshold becomes >= two thirds of the remaining.

predictions.S1: 'no movement' on >= 5 of 6 tasks (R is causally inert, F_R about 0)
predictions.S2: below S0 (H5) on >= 4 of 6; may move T05/T06
predictions.S3: more phrasing clusters per idea than S0 at matched alpha; little idea change; 'breakage first' by alpha 4
predictions.S5: 'no movement' at alpha 1-2, breakage at alpha 4
predictions.S1E_S2E: breakage (pass < 0.8 x twin) on >= 4 of 6 tasks

C3d.landing: edge (BiBFS, adjacent to BFS) rather than the opposite side
C3d.status: descriptive (2 gated survivors: exact permutation p floor 0.5)

failure_mode_rule.moves: correct-only excess >= 0.20 at some alpha with pass >= 0.8 x twin
failure_mode_rule.moves_with_cost: excess >= 0.10 only where pass < 0.8 x twin
failure_mode_rule.breakage_first: pass < 0.8 x twin or invalid >= 0.2 at an alpha where excess < 0.10
failure_mode_rule.no_movement: excess < 0.10 and pass >= 0.8 x twin at every alpha

hull.P15_P20: min cost with Hill >= 1.5 / 2.0, else not reached
hull.bootstrap: 2,000 replicates (reduced to >= 500 only if CPU time forces it, logged), programs resampled within cells stratified by template; hull max recomputed inside replicates (200 draws, grid 0.1)

measures.diversity: correct-only, mechanism-labelled; 'other', 'invalid', 'unresolved' own columns; rarefied Hill-1 at depth 25 (1,000 subsamples; own depth flagged if < 25 correct)
measures.phrasing_clusters: identifier-normalised AST 4-gram shingles, Jaccard connected components at theta 0.7/0.8/0.9, clusters per idea
measures.paired_flips: exact McNemar on off-default (all parseable attempts and correct-only), S0 vs each site over the 30 shared slots per (task, alpha); byte-identical code rates
measures.transmission: logistic GLM of correct-only off-default on log realised displacement at R (block 35) and separately log first-token KL, with site indicators and template and task fixed effects; S0 indicator CI excluding 0 -> site-specific beyond downstream dose; S3 analysed on its own step-wise KL
measures.pooled: mixed logistic off-default ~ site x log2(alpha) + (1|task) + (1|template) (descriptive)

novelty_audit.pool: every correct 'other' program from every arm
novelty_audit.judges: two blind judges from different families (exp18 ids) + tie-break model
novelty_audit.claim: 'no correct novel algorithm' only at a count of 0 confirmed; rule of three 3/N

predictions.holm: C1-site raw p enters the iteration's secondary Holm family (alongside the other secondary claims)

slot_and_seed_scheme.slot: (task, template, k); k 0-5 for N=30 cells, 0-9 for N=50 cells; smoke k >= 100; filler TWIN_X k >= 10
slot_and_seed_scheme.uniforms: u_stream(task, template, k) = PCG64(stable_seed(task, template, k))
slot_and_seed_scheme.batch: 20 rows of one (task, template), packed by priority
